SELECT 'sales_lines_web' AS k, count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS d, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS d2, min(sale_date)::VARCHAR AS mn, max(sale_date)::VARCHAR AS mx
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.store_id=900
UNION ALL
SELECT 'web_orders', count(*), count(DISTINCT web_order_id), 0, min(order_ts_utc)::VARCHAR, max(dispatch_ts_utc)::VARCHAR FROM fact_web_order
UNION ALL
SELECT 'fiscal_notloaded', count(*), 0, 0, min(period_start_date)::VARCHAR, max(period_end_date)::VARCHAR FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE NOT fully_loaded
UNION ALL
SELECT 'returns_web', count(*), count(DISTINCT return_line_id), 0, min(return_date)::VARCHAR, max(return_date)::VARCHAR FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key WHERE s.store_id=900

WITH params AS (SELECT DATE '2025-11-03' AS start_date, DATE '2026-10-04' AS end_date),
web_dispatch AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, status, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order
)
SELECT w.status, (w.dispatch_date IS NULL) AS no_dispatch, s.store_id = 900 AS is_web_store, p.category = 'ZZ Test' AS is_test,
       count(*) AS n, sum(f.net_amount) AS net, min(f.sale_date)::VARCHAR AS mn, max(f.sale_date)::VARCHAR AS mx,
       sum(CASE WHEN w.dispatch_date < DATE '2025-11-03' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dispatched_before
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
WHERE (s.store_id = 900 OR f.channel_code='WB' OR w.web_order_id IS NOT NULL) AND f.sale_date >= DATE '2025-10-25'
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 ORDER BY 1,2,3,4

WITH params AS (SELECT DATE '2025-11-03' AS start_date, DATE '2026-10-04' AS end_date),
web_dispatch AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
net_lines AS (
  SELECT w.dispatch_date AS business_date, p.sku, f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.net_amount AS sold_net
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.return_date, p.sku, -r.refund_net, 0
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(n.net_sales) DESC) AS rnk, n.sku, cp.product_name, cp.category, cp.subcategory,
       ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales),2) AS web_net_sales, ROUND(SUM(n.sold_net),2) AS sold_before_returns
FROM net_lines n CROSS JOIN params
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE n.business_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date
GROUP BY n.sku, cp.product_name, cp.category, cp.subcategory
ORDER BY web_net_sales DESC LIMIT 14

WITH web_dispatch AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
mine AS (
  SELECT sum(x) AS v FROM (
    SELECT f.net_amount AS x FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
      JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
      WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND w.dispatch_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-03' AND DATE '2026-10-04'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
      WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-03' AND DATE '2026-10-04') t
),
ctrl AS (SELECT sum(net_sales) AS v, min(business_date)::VARCHAR AS mn, max(business_date)::VARCHAR AS mx FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=900 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-03' AND DATE '2026-10-04'),
dupcur AS (SELECT count(*) AS c FROM (SELECT sku FROM dim_product WHERE is_current GROUP BY sku HAVING count(*)>1))
SELECT mine.v AS mine, ctrl.v AS control, ctrl.mn, ctrl.mx, dupcur.c AS skus_with_multiple_current FROM mine, ctrl, dupcur
